designationHistory.indexText: Establishment of the California Coastal National Monument

sources.name: American Presidency Project: Proclamation 7264—Establishment of the California Coastal National Monument, January 11, 2000

review.note: Proclamation 7264, 65 FR 2821, signed 2000-01-11; FR API and APP agree on number, date and President.

designationHistory.indexText: Boundary Enlargement of the California Coastal National Monument

sources.name: American Presidency Project: Proclamation 9089—Boundary Enlargement of the California Coastal National Monument, March 11, 2014

review.note: Proclamation 9089, 79 FR 14603, signed 2014-03-11; FR API and APP agree on number, date and President. Antiquities Act reservation of additional land; kept as a modification (a proclamation adding land is a designation under the Act), not treated as a mere boundary revision.
